channel.title: Mission: Impossible III
channel.desc: Now a trainer for IMF recruits, superspy Ethan Hunt is called back to active duty to confront the toughest foe he has ever faced: Owen Davian, an international broker of arms and information who is as cunning as he is ruthless. As Ethan searches for the missing agent, Davian emerges to threaten him and all that he holds dear, including the woman that he loves.
